description: This Java class 'HonoReceiver' is a component for connecting to an AMQP network within a JMeter testing environment. It manages consumer connections, message reception, time synchronization, and performance metrics collection for messages received from Hono-based IoT or messaging infrastructure.

classes.name: HonoReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages an AMQP message receiver within a JMeter test, handling connection setup, message processing, timing, and metrics reporting.

methods.name: HonoReceiver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the receiver with sampler configuration and prepares the client factory.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes connection and creates message consumer asynchronously, returns a CompletableFuture indicating success or failure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vert.x Future for establishing a connection to the Hono AMQP network.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates either a telemetry or event consumer based on the endpoint, returning a Future for the consumer.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Populates a JMeter SampleResult with the current batch metrics, including handling timing, success, errors, and message count.

methods.name: messageReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked upon message receipt; updates counters, extracts sender time if configured, and manages clock sync status.

methods.name: setSampleStartIfNotSetYet
methods.description: Sets the start timestamp for the current sample if it isn't already set.

methods.name: getSenderTime
methods.description: Retrieves sender time from a message, either from payload JSON or message properties based on configuration.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromJsonPayload
methods.description: Extracts sender time as a Long from JSON payload bytes.

methods.name: getSenderTimeFromMessageProperties
methods.description: Extracts sender time from message application properties.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and cleans up resources asynchronously.
